places.name: Duomo di Milano (Cathedral)
places.ai_summary: A stunning Gothic cathedral and one of the largest in the world, offering breathtaking rooftop views of Milan.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry 1 hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Book tickets online to skip the queue.

attribution.title: St Ambrose barring Theodosius from Milan Cathedral label QS:Len,"Saint Ambrose barring Theodosius I from Milan Cathedral"label QS:Lde,"hl. Ambrosius und Kaiser Theodosius"
attribution.author: Anthony van Dyck

places.name: Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II
places.ai_summary: A historic shopping arcade with luxury boutiques, cafes, and stunning 19th-century architecture.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for a lively atmosphere.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a coffee at one of the historic cafes.

attribution.title: 1Galleria VittorioEmanueleII
attribution.author: Manuel Pagani
attribution.description: This is a photo of a monument which is part of cultural heritage of Italy. This monument participates in the contest Wiki Loves Monuments Italia 2019. See authorisations. (wiki-ID: 03F2050035)

places.name: Sforza Castle (Castello Sforzesco)
places.ai_summary: A historic fortress housing museums and art collections, surrounded by beautiful gardens.

opening_hours.notes: Check for special exhibitions.

places.place_tip: Explore the museums and enjoy the gardens.

places.name: Santa Maria delle Grazie (The Last Supper)
places.ai_summary: A church and convent, home to Leonardo da Vinci's 'The Last Supper', a masterpiece of Renaissance art.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry at 6:45 PM. Closed on Mondays.

places.place_tip: Reserve tickets well in advance.
places.address: Piazza di Santa Maria delle Grazie, Milan, Italy

places.name: La Scala Opera House
places.ai_summary: One of the most prestigious opera houses in the world, known for its excellent acoustics and historic performances.

opening_hours.notes: Check performance schedule in advance.

places.place_tip: Attend a performance if possible.

places.name: Brera Art Gallery
places.ai_summary: An art gallery in the Brera district, hosting a fine collection of Italian Renaissance art.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry at 6:45 PM. Closed on Mondays.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the masterpiece 'The Kiss' by Hayez.

places.name: Navigli Canals District
places.ai_summary: A picturesque canal district known for its vibrant nightlife, restaurants, and art galleries.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for nightlife.

places.place_tip: Try the local aperitivo culture.

places.name: Piazza del Duomo
places.ai_summary: The main square of Milan, dominated by the stunning Duomo cathedral and surrounded by historic buildings.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning or evening.

places.place_tip: Visit the rooftop of the Duomo for stunning views.

places.name: Parco Sempione
places.ai_summary: A large city park located behind Sforza Castle, featuring walking paths, a lake, and the Triennale di Milano.

opening_hours.notes: Gates close at 9:00 PM.

places.place_tip: Visit the Triennale for contemporary art and design exhibitions.

places.name: Porta Nuova District
places.ai_summary: A modern district known for its skyscrapers, luxury shops, and vibrant nightlife.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for nightlife.

places.place_tip: Check out the vertical forest buildings.

places.name: Via Monte Napoleone (Luxury Street)
places.ai_summary: Famous for its high-end fashion boutiques and luxury brands, a must-visit for shopping enthusiasts.

opening_hours.notes: Luxury boutiques may have varying hours.

places.place_tip: Visit during the sales season for best deals.

places.name: San Siro Stadium
places.ai_summary: A famous football stadium, home to AC Milan and Inter Milan, offering guided tours and a museum.

opening_hours.notes: Check match schedule; tours may be affected.

places.place_tip: Visit the stadium store for official merchandise.
places.address: Piazzale Angelo Moratti, 20151 Milano MI, Italy

places.name: Cimitero Monumentale
places.ai_summary: A famous cemetery known for its monumental tombs and sculptures, set in a beautiful park-like area.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry at 5:30 PM.

places.place_tip: Look for the famous tombs and monuments.
places.address: Piazza Cimitero Monumentale, 20154 Milano MI, Italy

places.name: Museo del Novecento
places.ai_summary: A museum dedicated to 20th-century art, located near the Duomo, featuring works by Italian and international artists.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry at 6:45 PM. Closed on Mondays.

places.place_tip: Check out the rooftop terrace for great views.

attribution.title: Arengario Milano Museo 900
attribution.author: Fred Romero
attribution.description: Palazzo dell'Arengario in Milan, Italy, seat of the "Museo del Novecento" ("Museum of the 1900s") art gallery.

places.name: Corso Buenos Aires
places.ai_summary: A major shopping street in Milan, known for its wide range of stores, from high street to designer brands.

opening_hours.notes: Shops may have varying hours.

places.place_tip: Explore side streets for hidden gems.

places.name: Basilica di Sant’Ambrogio
places.ai_summary: A beautiful basilica with a rich history, known for its stunning mosaics and as the burial place of Saint Ambrose.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays.

places.place_tip: Admire the golden altar and ancient crypt.

wikimedia_commons.source_file: File:0039 - Milano - Sant'Ambrogio - Campanile dei canonici - sec XII-1889 - Foto Giovanni Dall'Orto 25-Apr-2007.jpg

attribution.author: G.dallorto
attribution.description: Milan. The so-called "Canons' church tower" (built in 12th century, but the top with the trifora was added only in 1889) as seen from the atrium of Sant'Ambrogio basilica. Picture by Giovanni Dall'Orto, April 25 2007.

places.name: Palazzo Reale
places.ai_summary: The Royal Palace of Milan, a historic palace with impressive architecture and art collections.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry at 6:45 PM.

places.place_tip: Check for temporary exhibitions.
places.address: Piazza del Duomo, 20122 Milano MI, Italy

places.name: Arco della Pace
places.ai_summary: A triumphal arch in the Sempione Park, commemorating those who fought for Italian unification.

opening_hours.notes: Best viewed at sunrise or sunset.

places.place_tip: Walk through the arch for a great photo op.

places.name: Leonardo da Vinci Museum of Science and Technology
places.ai_summary: A museum dedicated to Leonardo da Vinci, featuring interactive exhibits on science, technology, and art.
places.name_english: Museo Nazionale Scienza e Tecnologia Leonardo da Vinci

opening_hours.notes: Last entry at 6:00 PM. Closed on Mondays.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the section on da Vinci's inventions.
places.address: Via San Vittore, 21, 20123 Milano MI, Italy

places.name: CityLife Shopping District
places.ai_summary: A modern shopping district with a wide range of shops, restaurants, and entertainment options.

opening_hours.notes: Shops and restaurants may have varying hours.

places.place_tip: Check out the modern architecture in the area.
